# pve_node (Data Source)

One node: inventory entry, runtime status, and PVE version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `info` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node} (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
- `version` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--version))

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `boot_info` (Attributes) Meta-information about the boot mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--boot_info))
- `cpu` (Number) The current cpu usage.
- `cpuinfo` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--cpuinfo))
- `current_kernel` (Attributes) Meta-information about the currently booted kernel of this node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--current_kernel))
- `loadavg` (List of String) An array of load avg for 1, 5 and 15 minutes respectively.
- `memory` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--memory))
- `pveversion` (String) The PVE version string.
- `rootfs` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--rootfs))

<a id="nestedatt--status--boot_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.boot_info`

Read-Only:

- `mode` (String) Through which firmware the system got booted.
- `secureboot` (Boolean) System is booted in secure mode, only applicable for the "efi" mode.


<a id="nestedatt--status--cpuinfo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.cpuinfo`

Read-Only:

- `cores` (Number) The number of physical cores of the CPU.
- `cpus` (Number) The number of logical threads of the CPU.
- `model` (String) The CPU model
- `sockets` (Number) The number of logical threads of the CPU.


<a id="nestedatt--status--current_kernel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.current_kernel`

Read-Only:

- `machine` (String) Hardware (architecture) type
- `release` (String) OS kernel release (e.g., "6.8.0")
- `sysname` (String) OS kernel name (e.g., "Linux")
- `version` (String) OS kernel version with build info


<a id="nestedatt--status--memory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.memory`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number) The available memory in bytes.
- `free` (Number) The free memory in bytes.
- `total` (Number) The total memory in bytes.
- `used` (Number) The used memory in bytes.


<a id="nestedatt--status--rootfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.rootfs`

Read-Only:

- `avail` (Number) The available bytes in the root filesystem.
- `free` (Number) The free bytes on the root filesystem.
- `total` (Number) The total size of the root filesystem in bytes.
- `used` (Number) The used bytes in the root filesystem.



<a id="nestedatt--version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `version`

Read-Only:

- `release` (String) The current installed Proxmox VE Release
- `repoid` (String) The short git commit hash ID from which this version was build
- `version` (String) The current installed pve-manager package version
